column1: # The dungeon `G` Get and `O` Open refusal arms, which `cleak/u5-spec#262`
# published on 2026-09-12 and this engine had wrong in both cases.
# `commands.md` Section 5.3: "The dispatcher emits `Get-` only outside the
# dungeon band; the dungeon handler opens with its own `Get\n`,
# unconditionally, before it looks at anything." Section 5.8 adds that "Get on
# a non-chest prints `Get\nNot here!\n`" - not the surface cascade's
# `Nothing to get!`, which is what this engine printed.
# `dungeon-mode.md` Section 8.1's chest-command table gives Open's own arms:
# the dispatcher prints `Open-` "in **every** scene including this one", and an
# unrelated cell answers `What?\n`. "Because those last two carry no leading
# line feed they render on the prefix's own row, as `Open-Already Open!` and
# The party stands in an ordinary Deceit corridor, so both verbs take their
# no-chest arm. The chest arms themselves still need a seat beside a chest.
# requires-seed: the party inside Deceit facing a wall-class cell, with a torch
